steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: What now? LUNG wRATh have hit a government-issued ambush blockade.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: In all the frenzy, Ernesto's decided to take up the rear, and the two heroines have caught his key and left to press forward.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Ernesto's combat strength might be as impressive, but with this many enemies, his defeat could only be a matter of time anyway!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But as for the heroines, they've broken out of the entrapment, but ambushes still lie ahead! Can they really get away without a hitch?

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Oh? They've opened a door on the street and rushed inside!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: This store...

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Is one of Ernesto's.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: So that's their game! Looks like the key Ernesto left them works for sheltering in a shop of his.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But is this truly going to work out?

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Hold on! Director, switch cameras!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Alright, that's the REAL game! From another angle it all makes sense. This store has a back door.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: And we can see, there's a passage from that door through to the main street, and it hasn't been discovered by any other team's interference!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Is this LUNG wRATh's chance, or is it—
The words are still on D.D.D.'s lips when, there on the screen, the sound of a tremendous explosion comes from Ernesto's arms store.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Wh—Wh-Wh-What in the world is going on here?

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Lady Candela, is that an obstacle you installed as well?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: If it was, it wouldn't be as basic as blowing up this one single shop.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: This... could it be that another team knew Ernesto had this up his sleeve, and laid a trap?!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: If so, then we can say LUNG wRATh has been completely and utterly outdone!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: LUNG wRATh, is this what buries you?!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Wow... Miss Ch'en and Miss Lin will be okay, won't they?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Relax, they've both been around the block. A little explosion like that's not gonna get them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That said... this competition's no stranger to dirty play, but this one's a little too targeted.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wonder if Ch'en's got beef with someone here.

steps.name: Ambush A
steps.text: Grrr... what the hell's with this guy? I can't even hit him.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Uh... I think that's the way Miss Ch'en's bunch went.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Let's go take a look and see.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Hui-chieh, are you dead?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*. Like that would kill me.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You're alive. Good. Your bike?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Gone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yours?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Perfectly fine.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It seems our opposition didn't want us dead and buried either.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: As luck would have it, the exit is blocked.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Well, good for luck.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Your view?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We find a way out. What else?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What I'm asking is who did it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Looks like our intuition was on the mark.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Right. Ernesto couldn't hold it in, I'm guessing.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But don't you think it's odd? If I were him, this isn't how I'd do it.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Only one at the end of his rope would use such self-destructive means.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Maybe, it wasn't actually him.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Impossible.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Maybe, he wants us to think he's desperate.
Lin Yühsia raises her eyebrows, and leaves it be.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Right. Have you told Lady Candela about the matter?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How did she respond?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You won't do anything... will you?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: That's right, my girl. You're a smart one. You should be able to figure it out.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: If I sent someone to inspect the bombs now, wouldn't that just be telling the mastermind I've noticed their schemes?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: No matter, Ch'en. You and Lin have done very well already.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: To be frank, at the start I had no expectations you'd find anything at all, hahaha.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And you don't seem to care?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Of course, my girl.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: And you needn't worry about this too much.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: I've seen you and Lin put on a very good show in the championship. Why not forget all this, and try your very hardest for number one? You'll put a smile on Wei Yenwu's face too, hahaha.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'll take it into consideration.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You can probably imagine it.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Easily.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Now, how do we get out?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I heard a certain Special Inspection Unit Chief could dice apart a whole building in her rage. Mind showing me first-hand?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not every building's so sliceable. This one's clearly built from exceptionally sturdy stuff.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Can you use your sand ability to transport things?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm not my dad. A blockage of this level, with my ability, would need some time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then I'll have a go.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: No need. I have another method.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Can you guess what this is?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...A bomb?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you remember the bomb from the first round?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There was no way Lady Candela could conduct a wide search, but I had a few of the boys here dress up as thieves and enter the neighborhood to steal as many as they could.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thieves?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Thieves. So long as they gave the guards a bribe, and didn't make too much noise inside, no one would care about them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lin Yühsia.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You might be unalike, but I have always deeply respected you and Mr. Lin.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The slums couldn't go on without you, I know that much.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't let me catch you enjoying yourself.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Hui-chieh... nobody would ever assign themselves blame of their own accord.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Out of the way. I'm going to set the bomb.
